title: 实验 1-8 · 电源等效变换：诺顿 ⇄ 戴维宁
summary: 10 mA 电流源并 470Ω，和 4.7 V 电压源串 470Ω：用开关轮流接同一个负载，负载根本分不出来。
concepts: source transformation 电源等效变换
Thevenin 戴维宁（电压源 + R）
equivalent to the outside 对外等效
description:
**目标**：验证电源等效变换：电流源 Is 并联电阻 R，对外等效于电压源 Us = Is × R 串联同一个 R。

**电路**（两台稳压电源，负极都接 GND）：
- 诺顿（Norton）：PSU1 设 12 V、限流 0.01 A（CC 模式 = 10 mA 电流源），它的 + 端接 RN（470Ω）到 GND，+ 端就是端口 a；
- 戴维宁（Thevenin）：PSU2 设 **4.7 V**（= 10 mA × 470Ω），+ 端串 RT（470Ω），RT 的另一端是端口 b。

拨动开关 S1：a 侧接诺顿端口，b 侧接戴维宁端口，中间 com 接负载 RL（1kΩ）到 GND。

**先预测**：分别算出诺顿网络和戴维宁网络带 1kΩ 负载时 RL 上的电压，以及没接负载的那个网络的端口开路电压。思路：诺顿是 10 mA 分给 RN 和 RL；戴维宁是 4.7 V 在 RT 和 RL 上分压。两者对负载一样吗？两个内阻 RN、RT 的发热一样吗？

**测量**：S1 分别拨到 a 和 b，测 RL 上的电压和电流，以及另一个空着的端口对 GND 的电压。电路检查通过后，把读数填进下面的「测量」（以你自己的面包板为准）；答完后会显示计算对比。

en.title: Experiment 1-8 · Source transformation: Norton ⇄ Thevenin
en.summary: A 10 mA current source in parallel with 470Ω versus a 4.7 V source in series with 470Ω: switch the same load between them and it cannot tell the difference.
en.description:
**Goal**: verify source transformation: a current source Is in parallel with a resistor R behaves, seen from outside, exactly like a voltage source Us = Is × R in series with the same R.

**Circuit** (two bench supplies, both negatives to GND):
- Norton: PSU1 set to 12 V with a 0.01 A current limit (CC mode = a 10 mA current source); RN (470Ω) goes from its + terminal to GND, and the + terminal is port a;
- Thevenin: PSU2 set to **4.7 V** (= 10 mA × 470Ω), with RT (470Ω) in series from its + terminal; the far end of RT is port b.

Slide switch S1: side a to the Norton port, side b to the Thevenin port, the middle com to the load RL (1kΩ) to GND.

**Predict first**: work out the voltage on RL when the Norton network drives the 1kΩ load and when the Thevenin network does, and the open-circuit voltage of the network left without the load. Method: in the Norton network 10 mA is shared by RN and RL; in the Thevenin network 4.7 V divides over RT and RL. Does the load see any difference? Do RN and RT get equally warm?

**Measure**: with S1 on a and then on b, measure the voltage and current of RL and the unused port's voltage to GND. Once the circuit check passes, type your readings into the Measurements below (whatever your own board shows); the worked comparison appears after you answer.

measurements.ask: S1 on a (Norton drives the load): voltage across RL
measurements.explain: 10 mA shared by RN and RL: V = 10 mA × (470 ∥ 1000 = 319.7 Ω) ≈ 3.20 V.

measurements.ask: S1 on b (Thevenin drives the load): voltage across RL
measurements.explain: 4.7 V divided by RT and RL: 4.7 × 1000 / 1470 ≈ 3.20 V, the same as Norton.

measurements.ask: S1 on a: the current in the Norton resistor RN
measurements.explain: 10 mA − 3.2 mA ≈ 6.8 mA; RN dissipates ≈ 21.7 mW.

measurements.ask: S1 on b: the current in the Thevenin resistor RT
measurements.explain: RT is in series with RL, so it carries the load current ≈ 3.2 mA; RT dissipates only ≈ 4.8 mW.

measurements.ask: From your four readings, source transformation is
measurements.explain: A transformation only keeps the port's U–I relation: equivalent outside, not inside. With no load the Norton RN burns 47 mW all the time; the Thevenin RT burns nothing.
choices: equivalent for the load (RL sees the same), but the currents and heating in the internal resistors differ
fully equivalent: the internal resistors carry the same current too
not equivalent at all: the load voltage differs too

hints: Two supplies: one on the top power rails, the other on the bottom rails, and a jumper joining the two blue (−) rails as a common GND.
PSU1: 12 V, current limit 0.01 A (so it goes into CC mode); PSU2: 4.7 V.
S1 side a to the Norton port (the column with PSU1 + and RN), side b to the far end of RT, com to RL.
tests: Switch on a (Norton): sensible voltage and current on RL; Thevenin port open
Switch on b (Thevenin): RL gets the same as on a; Norton port open

tests.name: 拨到 a（诺顿）：RL 上的电压、电流合理；戴维宁端口开路
拨到 b（戴维宁）：RL 上和拨到 a 时一样；诺顿端口开路

compare:
**对比**：
- 诺顿带负载：V = 10 mA × (470 ∥ 1000 = 319.7Ω) ≈ **3.20 V**；
- 戴维宁带负载：V = 4.7 × 1000 / 1470 ≈ **3.20 V**；
- 空着的端口：诺顿 10 mA × 470Ω = 4.70 V，戴维宁也是 4.70 V。

所以 S1 拨到 a 或 b，RL 上都是 ≈ 3.20 V、≈ 3.20 mA；另一个空着的端口都是 ≈ 4.70 V（模拟器：3.196 V 和 3.197 V，差别来自 CC 模式的 9.99 mA）。电压差得多时，检查 PSU1 是不是真的进入了 CC 模式、PSU2 是不是设成了 4.7 V。

**但内部不一样**：带 1kΩ 负载时，诺顿里的 RN 流过 6.8 mA，发热 ≈ 21.7 mW；戴维宁里的 RT 只流 3.2 mA，发热 ≈ 4.8 mW。空载时差别更大：诺顿的 RN 一直在耗 47 mW，戴维宁一点都不耗。所以说等效变换是**对外等效**，对内不等效。

measurements.ask: S1 拨到 a（诺顿带负载）：RL 两端电压
S1 拨到 b（戴维宁带负载）：RL 两端电压
measurements.explain: 4.7 V 在 RT 和 RL 上分压：4.7 × 1000 / 1470 ≈ 3.20 V，和诺顿一样。

measurements.ask: S1 拨到 a：诺顿内阻 RN 里的电流
measurements.explain: 10 mA − 3.2 mA ≈ 6.8 mA，RN 发热 ≈ 21.7 mW。

measurements.ask: S1 拨到 b：戴维宁内阻 RT 里的电流
measurements.explain: RT 和 RL 串联，电流就是负载电流 ≈ 3.2 mA，RT 发热只有 ≈ 4.8 mW。

choices: 对负载等效（RL 上一样），但内阻里的电流和发热不一样
完全等效：内阻里的电流也一样
都不等效：负载电压也不一样
measurements.ask: 根据你的四个读数，电源等效变换是：
measurements.explain: 等效变换只保证端口的 U–I 关系相同，对外等效、对内不等效。空载时诺顿的 RN 一直耗 47 mW，戴维宁的 RT 一点都不耗。

hints: 两台电源：一台用上方的电源轨，另一台用下方的电源轨，再用一根跳线把两条蓝轨（−）连起来作为共同的 GND。
PSU1：12 V、限流 0.01 A（让它进 CC 模式）；PSU2：4.7 V。
S1 的 a 侧接诺顿端口（PSU1 + 和 RN 那一列），b 侧接 RT 的另一端，com 接 RL。
